subject.title: [codex] fix(sessions): report archive cleanup in sessions cleanup

question: Should an agent-scoped `sessions cleanup` retain the proposed rule of skipping archive deletion whenever another configured agent shares that directory, while explicit `--store` remains a full offline repair for the selected directory?
rationale: This is a destructive ownership boundary: the branch has regression coverage for the chosen behavior, but source inspection cannot determine whether that operator-facing policy is the permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve scoped archive ownership
options.body: Keep agent-scoped cleanup non-destructive for shared directories, deduplicate `--all-agents`, and preserve explicit `--store` as the full offline-repair path.

options.title: Narrow explicit cleanup further
options.body: Require a more restrictive ownership signal before deleting any shared-directory archive, accepting less cleanup coverage in exchange for a simpler safety boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped archive ownership
recommendation.body: Keep agent-scoped cleanup non-destructive for shared directories, deduplicate `--all-agents`, and preserve explicit `--store` as the full offline-repair path.
